title: Dual-Channel Robust Group-Relative Policy Optimization via Advantage and Sequence-Weight Estimation
abstract: arXiv:2609.36944v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Group-relative policy optimization relies on reward-derived advantages and sequence-level likelihood weights, both of which can be sensitive to localized outliers. Extreme rewards can collapse the contrast among clean responses after group normalization, while token-level log-ratio perturbations can alter sequence weights and clipping decisions. We introduce RoVR-GSPO, a dual-channel robust optimizer that addresses these failure modes separately. Its reward channel combines robust reference estimation with bounded residual credit, while its ratio channel uses differentiable SoftRoVR aggregation to construct robust sequence weights. We provide stability and efficiency analyses for both channels. Experiments on mathematical reasoning, long-context summarization, and tool-call annotation show consistent improvements over GSPO, while controlled perturbation studies demonstrate stronger robustness to reward contamination and token-ratio anoma

translated_title: 基于优势与序列权重估计的双通道鲁棒组相对策略优化
translated_abstract: 组相对策略优化依赖于由奖励推导的优势和序列级似然权重，而这两者都可能对局部离群值敏感。极端奖励可能在组归一化后使干净响应之间的对比度坍塌，而token级对数比扰动可能改变序列权重和裁剪决策。我们提出了RoVR-GSPO，一种双通道鲁棒优化器，可分别应对这些失效模式。其奖励通道将鲁棒参考估计与有界残差信用相结合，而其比率通道使用可微分的SoftRoVR聚合来构建鲁棒的序列权重。我们为这两个通道提供了稳定性与效率分析。在数学推理、长文本摘要和工具调用标注任务上的实验表明，该方法相比GSPO取得了一致的改进，同时受控扰动研究证明其对奖励污染和token比率异常具有更强的鲁棒性。
tldr: 提出双通道鲁棒优化器RoVR-GSPO，通过奖励通道的鲁棒参考估计与有界残差信用、以及比率通道的可微分SoftRoVR聚合，分别解决组相对策略优化中极端奖励和token级对数比扰动导致的敏感性问题，在多项任务上稳定超越GSPO。
en_tdlr: RoVR-GSPO is a dual-channel robust optimizer that separately addresses reward outliers and token-ratio perturbations in group-relative policy optimization via robust reference estimation with bounded residual credit and differentiable SoftRoVR aggregation, consistently outperforming GSPO across multiple tasks.
